blurb: Guests skydive from a Bell 412 Super Huey helicopter over the Atlantic Ocean and land on Melbourne Beach. Tandem skydiving is offered with USPA-certified instructors, including video packages. Experienced jumpers can book fun jumps with required gear and AADs. A unique Skydive BnB package offers private drop zone access with accommodations and transport.
extraNote: Call to schedule your jump; most weekends available but book in advance · Retired & Active Military $200 OFF single jumper pricing · Melbourne International Airport
